transcript.text: Make a realistic, silent 15-second widescreen story in three shots: a woman with a freckled face and red pixie cut drops a red scarf; a man with a shaved head and round glasses picks it up; he returns it and they smile. Both adults, on a quiet street. Show both faces clearly in every shot and keep exactly the same two faces throughout—no changing actors between cuts.

Your 15-second film "The Red Scarf" is done:
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/a5c716f7da8e4197acc184fed8207189.mp4

- Shot 1: on a quiet tree-lined street, the woman with freckles and a red pixie cut drops her red scarf. The man with the shaved head and round glasses is walking behind her.
- Shot 2: he bends down and picks up the scarf.
- Shot 3: he hands it back and they smile at each other.
- 16:9 widescreen at 854×480 (the highest resolution on the free plan), realistic style, no sound.

To keep the same two faces, each shot starts from the last frame of the shot before. I didn't cast new people at the cuts.

- Not checked: I can't watch the video, so I haven't confirmed that the faces stay the same, that both faces are clear in every shot, or that the three actions happen in order. Please watch it. If a face drifts or turns away, tell me which shot and I'll remake just that shot.
